items.title: Amazon recognized as a Cool Vendor™ in Innovations in Supply Chain Planning Technology
items.summary: Supply chain planners today spend too much time triaging exceptions and coordinating across disconnected systems and not enough time on the strategic decisions that drive business outcomes. At AWS, we’ve been working to change that with Amazon Connect Decisions, an AI-native supply chain planning and decisioning platform built on Amazon’s 30 years of operational science. […]
items.creator: Dave Campbell
